## New Lab-only implementation — partial policy evidence
src/screens/LabOnlyWalkIn.tsx and lab-walkin-policy.ts implement name/mobile-only NEW LabOnly identity with optional tests. No OPD ticket, doctor queue or payment is sent in that registration action. Zero tests needs neither a doctor nor catalogue availability. InHouse requires Active laboratory; SendOut independently requires Active outsourced_diagnostics and displays the actual partner. Inactive/missing/duplicate catalogue selections are refused and current service/catalogue rechecked before a new write. App uses scoped-handbook and server-view navigation, with separate permission-based collection/report actions. Generated types and full bundle including omitted sections were read/refreshed from MCP.
